  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in East Africa, specifically examining the East African Community (EAC) and its efforts to harmonize TVET curricula across member states. It addresses harmonization across institutions and countries within the EAC region, focusing on regional frameworks, cross-border education, and mutual recognition of qualifications. The paper discusses the EAC Protocol on Education and Training, which aims to facilitate the mutual recognition of academic and professional qualifications.",
  "Title": "Harmonization of TVET Curricula in East Africa: Progress, Challenges, and Prospects",

    "APA_Reference": "Mwatelah, C. K. K., Poipoi, M., & Waceke, A. K. (2023). Harmonization of TVET Curricula in East Africa: Progress, Challenges, and Prospects. African Journal of Teacher Education, 18(2), 124-141. https://doi.org/10.21083/ajote.v18i2.7515"

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Progress has been made in harmonizing TVET curricula in East Africa, particularly in priority sectors.",
      "The EAC Protocol on Education and Training provides a framework for mutual recognition of qualifications.",
      "Challenges remain in terms of implementation, funding, and capacity building.",
      "The involvement of industry and other stakeholders is crucial for the success of harmonization efforts."
    ],
    "Challenges_Barriers": [
      "Lack of political will and commitment from some member states",
      "Inadequate funding and resources",
      "Capacity gaps in TVET institutions",
      "Differences in national TVET systems and standards",
      "Resistance to change from some stakeholders",
      "Language barriers"
    ],
    "Success_Factors": [

      "Effective coordination and collaboration among stakeholders",
      "Adequate funding and resources",
      "Capacity building for TVET instructors and assessors",
      "Alignment of TVET curricula with industry needs",
      "Use of technology to support harmonization efforts"
    ],

      "Increase funding for TVET harmonization",
      "Enhance capacity building for TVET instructors and assessors",
      "Promote the use of technology in TVET",

      "Address language barriers"
